b.lede: AMD's Radeon RX 9060 XT has reached a new GPU frequency world record of 4,837 MHz. AMD VP Jack Huynh and veteran overclocker Bill Alverson used liquid nitrogen cooling to help the smaller RDNA 4 GPU open a 48MHz gap over the previous world record run.
b.title: AMD's Radeon RX 9060 XT sets new GPU frequency world record of 4.837 GHz
